items.source: Resolve an error view for the specified details.
items.translation: 解析指定详情的错误视图。

items.source: Interface that can be implemented by beans that resolve error views.
items.translation: 可由解析错误视图的 Bean 实现的接口。

items.source: a resolved ModelAndView or null
items.translation: 一个已解析的ModelAndView或null

items.source: status - the http status of the error
model - the suggested model to be used with the view
items.translation: model - 建议与视图一起使用的模型

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
